title: Complete the End-to-End Capstone Workflow
description: Execute the complete professional developer lifecycle on your `hcc-git-practice` repository and share your repository link in the HCC community!
steps: 1. Open an Issue: Title `Add Capstone Completion Badge to README` (#2)
2. Ensure local `main` is fresh: `git switch main && git pull origin main`
4. Edit `README.md` to add: `### 🎓 Completed 15-Day HCC Git & GitHub Programme` and an achievement list
5. Review diff: `git diff` — verify only the expected lines changed
6. Stage & Commit: `git add README.md && git commit -m "feat: add capstone completion badge to README"`
8. Open PR: write `Closes #2` in description, review diff in Files Changed, and merge it
9. Sync local: `git switch main && git pull origin main && git branch -d feature/capstone-badge`
10. Verify: run `git log --graph --oneline` — admire your complete, professional, 15-day Git history!
expected_output: Your repository features clean commits, merged PRs, closed issues, and a completed badge on README.md.
tips: Pin this practice repository to your GitHub profile as tangible proof of your Git skills!
Every project you build in college, hackathons, or personal learning from now on should follow this exact workflow.
